title: Certifications: PMI, ITIL, Prince2, Scrum and the cloud ones

videos.script: A certificate is a signal to somebody who does not know you yet. A recruiter with three hundred applications. A tender that scores your team. {{signal}} It is not proof that you can run a good project. Fourteen lessons of this course were about that, and it is learned by doing it. {{doing}} This lesson goes through the certificates the market asks for: PMP and PRINCE2 for projects, Scrum and SAFe for agile, ITIL for operations, and the cloud architect exams. {{tour}} For each, what it requires, what it shows, and how often you will pay to keep it. {{renewal}} And it starts with a warning. This is the part of the course that ages fastest, so check the certifying body's own page before you pay for anything. {{warning}}
